title: Smarter Weather examples index
description: One entry per example, surface and language. An example in several languages, or on several surfaces (REST and an SDK), is several entries sharing one id; (id, surface, language) is unique, which the validator checks. Growth is additive: readers ignore fields they do not know and render a surface or language they do not know as plain text, so a new field, surface or language keeps a file valid for every version-1 reader. `version` changes only when an existing field changes meaning.

id.description: URL slug (developers.smarterweather.com/examples/<id>/), shared by every surface and language of the same example.

surface.description: The top-level directory the example lives in. An open list so a new surface is additive; in use: rest (plain HTTP calls), mcp (an MCP client wired to the weather server), sdk (reserved for when an SDK ships).

language.description: An open list; in use: curl, javascript, typescript, python, go, json.

kind.description: What the harness checks. code: a program that calls the API and opens with the placeholder key constant. config: a client config that holds no key at all. A closed list, because a new kind needs new checks.

dir.description: Directory under examples/, starting with the surface.

portal_guide.description: Playground guide slug on developers.smarterweather.com, when one matches.

test.description: Shell command CI runs in dir (see _harness/). Entries without one are listed but not run.
